context: A uni student teases his teen sister at the cafe
purpose: Teach: ケータイ/オタク/あらかじめ/あきらめ/ものすごく/ビックリ/とりわけ/ひたすら

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: またケータイばっかり見て、お前ほんとアイドルオタクだよな。
lines.en: On your phone again, huh? You're seriously such an idol otaku.
lines.style: Teasing older-brother tone, casual and slightly mocking but affectionate.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うるさい!言っとくけど、今日は推しの配信あるから邪魔しないでよ。
lines.en: Shut up! Just so you know, my fave's livestream is on today, so don't bother me.
lines.style: Defensive teen pushback, sharp and a little whiny, natural casual register.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: へえ、ものすごく真剣な顔してるじゃん。勉強もそのくらい頑張ればいいのに。
lines.en: Wow, you look incredibly serious. If only you studied that hard.
lines.style: Mock-impressed needling with a smirk in the voice, teasing affection.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: てかお兄ちゃんに言われたくないんですけど。去年の成績ビックリするほど悪かったくせに。
lines.en: I mean, I don't wanna hear it from you. Your grades last year were shockingly bad.
lines.style: Snappy comeback with triumphant teen energy and casual sneer.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: うっ、それ言うなって。今はひたすら頑張ってるから、あらかじめ言っておくぞ。
lines.en: Ugh, don't bring that up. I'm grinding away now, just so you know in advance.
lines.style: Wounded defensive whine shifting to mock-serious warning, dropping cocky tone.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ふーん、じゃあ私のこと笑うのもうあきらめてくれる?
lines.en: Hmm, so will you give up on making fun of me already?
lines.style: Smug teen victory, drawing out the words playfully with sing-song tone.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: それは無理。妹いじりは兄の特権、とりわけお前みたいな生意気な妹はね。
lines.en: No way. Teasing my sister is a brother's privilege, especially a cheeky one like you.
lines.style: Recovered grin, playful declaration with mock seriousness and affectionate jab.
